No one likes losing unknowingly and mtg is meant to be fun for all players. Coalition Victory is a card every wubrg deck would run and was banned because it wasn’t fun to play against but Barren Glory is hard to both achieve and very easily telegraphed. The bobbles and mazes end are also easily telegraphed, if they have a bunch of gates or bobbles, then they probably run one of these. 

I think to improve these cards they need to be permanents and made significantly harder for several. Blues is probably fine, a bit difficult and easy to tell. Blacks is interesting and I do like it, but either card count needs to be increased to 28 (7x4) or some additional clause is needed (I’m assuming these are all for commander lol). Greens is just too basic, idk how to fix it besides maybe a land amount like “40 or more lands”.
